equations: Rejected original model, preserved for audit: xdot=alpha*r-x/tau.
For constant production: x(t)=x0*exp(-t/tau)+alpha*r*tau*(1-exp(-t/tau)); after production stops at T, x(t)=x(T)*exp(-(t-T)/tau).
Before arrest: qdot=kn*max(x-xc,0)-kd*q. At first upward crossing x>=xc, qdot=0 permanently.

For trajectories starting x0=0 below xc, qdot source is zero up to crossing; hence q(t)=q0*exp(-kd*t) before crossing, and q(t)=q0*exp(-kd*tc) after crossing. If no crossing, q=q0*exp(-kd*t) throughout. This exact consequence is independent of kn.
